title: Tantei wa mou, Shindeiru. Season 2

thread.title: The Detective is Already Dead Season 2 • Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. Season 2 - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters found the central conflict confusing, forced, or poorly justified.
Some felt the writing relied too heavily on arbitrary decisions, plot armor, and incoherent story logic.
The episode’s character motivations drew criticism, though one commenter hoped a frustrating character might gain more conviction.
A few reactions appreciated the show’s energetic, exaggerated action and humorous absurdity.
One viewer admitted the series remains appealing largely because of Siesta despite its lack of coherence.
